english.title: Fail to give name / address to authorised person under the Transport for London Railway Byelaws
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person who was reasonably suspected by an authorised person of breaching or attempting to breach byelaw **(..SPECIFY BYELAW..) of the Transport for London Railway Byelaws 2011, failed to give your

(A)_[name]_
(B)_[address]_
(C)_[name and address]_

when requested to do so by the authorised person
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 22(1) and 23 of the Transport for London Railway Byelaws 2011.
